escena: SCENE (documentary, a real photograph inside Efeonce's creative studio in Santiago in the evening, during a shoot review): a creative of about thirty, seen from behind at three-quarters, his face turned away toward the wall and never visible, is caught mid-gesture pinning the last of about twenty photographic test prints onto a dark felt wall, his right arm raised and his thumb pressing a pin, his left hand holding two more prints. He wears the Efeonce hoodie exactly as in its back reference: across his upper back, the COMPLETE Efeonce screen print of that reference, the full white wordmark with the rocket inside the «o» and the line «Empower your Growth» centred under it, at the same size and position, matte ink resting on the fleece and following its folds; nothing printed or embroidered on the sleeves or shoulders. The prints are black-and-white and colour tests of one product shoot, a fictitious matte ceramic bottle in hard side light, slightly different exposures, no readable text, no logos. ONE print carries a small round vivid orange (#FF6500) sticker, the only warm accent in the frame. The only light is a small articulated desk lamp clamped at the left edge of the wall, its cool white head visible in frame, raking across the prints and his shoulder; the far side of his body falls into shadow; one blue glow of a monitor far behind him, out of focus. Current-generation equipment only; no plants, no mugs, no clutter. Camera about two metres behind him at shoulder height, 50mm f/2. Real fabric texture, real sensor grain, genuine depth of field. No readable text except the hoodie print, no logos of any other brand.

lecho.objeto: the out-of-focus dark edge of a cutting table right in front of the lens, outside the lamp's light
